refined_nucleus: A thin, flexible, and compressible silicone material is integrated into the staple line to provide real-time compression feedback, utilizing a novel deformation mechanism and signal transmission method, and a machine learning algorithm to adapt to varying tissue compression, with the addition of a high-precision pressure sensor to validate the material's deformation mechanism and signal transmission method.
new_relationship: The high-precision pressure sensor validates the material's deformation mechanism and signal transmission method, ensuring accurate real-time compression feedback.
new_configuration: The high-precision pressure sensor is integrated into the staple line, alongside the compressible material, to provide a secondary validation mechanism.
new_control_rule: Step 3: Validate compressible material deformation and signal transmission via high-precision pressure sensor before comparing measured compression to desired range.
refined_structure: The compressible material and high-precision pressure sensor are embedded within the staple line, extending from the staple's base to the tissue interface.
